cand.title: OENOVITI International Symposium and General Assembly 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence; venue commitment reduces current access but supports targeted overflow/future capture.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: No named person is verified as controlling 2027 hotel contracts. Pierre-Louis Teissedre is the network head/coordinator; Agathe Lairy and Marie Arduin are named OENOVITI network-team contacts in the official 2026 programme. The coordination office explicitly handles event organization, making those contacts relevant routing points; their 2027 responsibilities need confirmation. Marc Schmid, CHANGINS director, is a local-host escalation/routing candidate, not a verified accommodation buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced upcoming edition: 19–21 May 2027, Nyon, Switzerland; theme: Viticulture 2030: Addressing Environmental, Social and Human Challenges. These are activity dates, corroborated by the host calendar, not article dates. The host calendar says registration opens 1 December 2026. No official 2028 edition announcement was located; annual recurrence is not a 2028 date or destination commitment.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a plausible alternative lodging base for this Nyon/La Côte academic meeting, rather than downtown-Geneva megashow housing or a destination-resort buyout. The published venue is already academic, so do not sell a replacement plenary as current demand. Potential business is a modest participant-led room allocation and, only if requested, a small side meeting or meal. Nearly 130 participants from 15 countries were reported at Changins in 2017; this historical scale is compatible with a mid-size event but is neither a 2027 forecast nor a room count. Do not assume 20–120 rooms, 237 rooms, or any overnight conversion without organizer evidence. Transport to Changins and/or the B&B activity pickup point must be agreed; no YOTEL transfer arrangement is published.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: Changins, Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland, co-hosted by CHANGINS | Haute école de viticulture et œnologie and Agroscope. This is in the Nyon/La Côte territory, not Geneva city or Lausanne. School postal address: Route du Duillier 52, CH-1260 Nyon; Agroscope Changins: Route de Duillier 60, 1260 Nyon. These are institutional addresses, not proof of the specific session building or room. Exact session building/room remains unverified. Academic/research venue, not a competing hotel. The announced hosting commitment is not evidence of a hotel contract.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sequence: Changins, Switzerland, symposium 16 May 2017; Japan, 11–15 May 2023; Asti, Italy, 14–15 May 2024; Vienna, Austria, 22–23 May 2025; Porto, Portugal, 20–22 May 2026; announced Nyon/Changins 19–21 May 2027. Annual network events are explicitly described by the organizer, but destination rotation means no annual Swiss lodging demand can be assumed. The 2017 return precedent supports a local relationship, not a regular Swiss cycle.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Individual delegate booking with an edition-specific recommended hotel, not an identified housing bureau or open RFP. Organizer quote: “OENOVITI Members will need to make their own accommodation bookings”. The only hotel named in the reviewed 2027 accommodation instructions is Hôtel B&B NYON, 20 Allée de la Petite Prairie, 1260 Nyon; identification code NOVITI27. Organizer quote: “Activities will depart and return to this location.” Host quote: “You are, of course, free to choose alternative accommodation to suit your needs.” No room allotment, contracted volume, rate, release date, exclusivity or organizer-paid block is published. This is stronger than a generic hotel list but is not proof that rooms are contracted or available.
findings.organizationStructure: OENOVITI is an international academic/industry research and training network, not evidenced as a PCO, DMC or hotel-buying agency. Its Bordeaux/Institute of Vine and Wine Sciences coordination office handles event organization. An Executive Committee administers the network; ADERA collects membership fees, manages network finances and supports project management. CHANGINS and Agroscope are the 2027 local co-hosts. Network administration and financial support do not establish hotel procurement authority.
findings.competitiveLimitations: B&B HOTEL Nyon has an edition-specific recommendation, NOVITI27 booking identification and the operational advantage of being the activity departure/return point. This limits alternative-hotel convenience. No evidence was located of B&B sellout, a capacity shortage, displaced delegates, confirmed overflow, negotiated price parity or a paid room block. Do not label YOTEL an overflow hotel or preferred hotel without organizer agreement.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Agathe Lairy and Marie Arduin through oenoviti@u-bordeaux.fr, referencing the published 2026 team listing; copy/escalate to Pierre-Louis Teissedre if needed. Ask who coordinates 2027 accommodation and local transfers, whether an additional self-booking hotel may be circulated, and whether B&B has any protected allocation or exclusivity. Request expected residential delegates, arrival/departure nights and budget before quoting a right-sized allocation within the hotel’s supplied commercial band. Offer a transport-costed alternative, not an unsolicited whole-hotel or plenary bid. Seek an introduction to the local CHANGINS/Agroscope organizer; Marc Schmid is a director-level routing option. Registration is scheduled to open 1 December 2026, so a permission-based approach before then is commercially timely, not evidence of an RFP deadline.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 lodging is accessible in principle through participant choice: the host explicitly permits alternative accommodation. However, YOTEL has no published official status, booking link, allocation or transfer plan. The conference venue and recommended lodging pathway are already announced. Classification: hotel sourcing unconfirmed for YOTEL; conditional alternative lodging, not a broadly open accommodation tender and not fully committed exclusive housing elsewhere.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue local CHANGINS/Agroscope relationships for later workshops, visiting researchers or a future Swiss-hosted edition, subject to actual programme announcements and requirements. The 2017 and 2027 Changins editions establish a return precedent, while intervening international hosts show rotation. No 2028 local venue/date or transferable recurring hotel contract is established.
